Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal kickoff & capacity runway — Cirrus Health (QBR scheduling)

Hi Sarah —

Hope you had a good week. Per our contract timeline, your current term with Redwood ends 2028-01-31, so I wanted to kick off renewal planning now to:

- Lock in the capacity uplift you mentioned (up to +2.5x burst)
- Agree on any term changes or seat reallocation for next year
- Schedule a short QBR to align execs and Ops before we finalize commercial terms

I've attached a draft mutual action plan (Cirrus_MAP_v2.xlsx) with suggested milestones, ownership, and a proposed capacity runway through Q2 2028. Key open items we should decide together:

1) Target commit shape (monthly steady vs. staircase + burst)
2) Any regulatory evidence you need for private deployment or retention changes
3) Ramp milestones and a targeted QBR window

Proposed next steps (quick):
- You review the MAP and mark changes in the Drive link below
- Pick a 30-minute slot for the QBR (I included three options in the Calendly link)
- We’ll loop Procurement once we land on commit shape to start legal/PO work

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/Cirrus-MAP-v2
Calendly (QBR): https://calendly.com/redwood-qbr/30min

Thanks — want to make this low-friction. If easier, I can send a one-page term summary for your procurement team.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference

Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff & capacity runway — Cirrus Health (QBR scheduling)

Thanks Naomi — we appreciate the proactive outreach. Quick answers:

- We are targeting an average 1.5x commit with the ability to burst to 2.5x during clinical peak periods (December and March).
- Procurement will need a one-page commercial summary and any SOC2/compliance artifacts. I cc'd procurement.
- For QBRs, our exec team prefers end-of-month windows; currently 12/30 or 1/26 work best.

Can you confirm whether Reserved Dedicated pools can be split across two regions? We sometimes run cross-region fallbacks for DR. Also please note: our security team will ask for retention policy details if we increase request volumes.

Sarah
Sarah Li
Head of Data Platforms, Cirrus Health
sarah@cirrushealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0129
